[[File:MorlishVeed.jpg|thumb|Morlish Veed, Regent of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]
{{Quote|I will again assume the duties all Wyyrlok have held while our Master rests in stasis&mdash;as the ''voice'' of our Lord Krayt and ''regent'' of the Sith Order.|Darth Wyyrlok III|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 34">[[Legacy (2006) 34|''Legacy'' (2006) 34]]</ref>}}
A '''regent''' was the title held by a temporary ruler serving in the absence of a monarch, notably in the case of [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]], and [[Kallos Sook]] of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] princely city state of [[Kaadara]]. [[Zelor]] held the title of Lord Regent during his rule of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]].

In the case of the [[One Sith]], various [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], each bearing in turn the name of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Wyyrlok|Wyyrlok]], bore the title while the One Sith's leader, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]], went into [[Prison|stasis]]. The Regent was considered the "[[voice]]" of the Dark Lord and commanded in his stead. By [[137 ABY]], a [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|third Wyyrlok]] assumed control of the One [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as regent after killing the Dark Lord on [[Had Abbadon]].

Regent was also the title given to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]] when he agreed to act as a figurehead for Darth Wyyrlok and the public face of the reborn [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Assault on the Temple of the Sith|death]] of Darth Wyyrlok at the hands of his former Master, Darth Krayt reclaimed control of both the One Sith and the Empire. His first act was to relieve Veed from his position as Regent.
